description:
Account state + billing. Returns URLs only -- user clicks to pay; never charges silently.

Pick by intent:
  "what plan am I on?" -> info (tier, subscription, capabilities, upgrade/downgrade SKUs; permanent tiers og/truebeliever/ogdev cannot downgrade)
  "what can I buy?" / "how much is Pro?" -> plans (buyable SKU list)
  "upgrade me" / "buy Pro annual" -> checkout (needs sku_id) -> Stripe URL
  "cancel" / "update card" / "invoices" -> portal -> Stripe URL (free users with no Stripe record -> pointer to plans+checkout)
  "support Gnosis" / "tip" -> donate (amount_cents 100-500000; cumulative badge: 500c supporter / 5000c silver / 25000c gold)
After checkout/donate, Stripe webhook flips tier server-side; next init reflects it.
name: account
